# Hola Credit

> Explainable cash-flow assessments for Namibian lenders and retailers reviewing applicants without fixed salary patterns.

## What it does

Hola Credit structures cash-flow evidence from bank statements to support informed lending decisions for microlenders and retail credit providers in Namibia. It is built by Tangison Technologies in Windhoek.

## Key pages

- `/` — Homepage: how Hola Credit works, who it serves
- `/product` — Product overview and features
- `/how-scoring-works` — From statement to reviewable evidence
- `/security` — Data protection, consent, and retention
- `/for-microlenders` — Underwriting for irregular-income applicants
- `/for-retailers` — Credit assessment at the point of sale
- `/about` — Company background and team
- `/contact` — Request pilot access
- `/consent` — Consent framework and data governance
- `/faq` — Frequently asked questions
- `/privacy` — Privacy policy
- `/terms` — Terms of service
- `/brand` — Brand guidelines and assets
- `/resources` — Guides on statement readiness, responsible credit, and irregular income
- `/resources/statement-readiness` — Statement readiness guide
- `/resources/responsible-credit` — Responsible credit review
- `/waitlist` — Join the waitlist for early access

## Access

The product is in pilot evaluation for authorised Namibian lenders. Demo access is available at `/app` with synthetic data.
